slides.headline: is your sign *ophiuchus* now?
slides.dek: the 13th sign comes back every winter. here is the honest version

slides.headline: “nasa added a 13th sign, so your sign changed”
slides.body: nasa didn't add a sign. it explained that the sun's path crosses 13 constellations, and that the constellations have drifted from the signs over about 2,000 years. that's astronomy, not a new zodiac.

slides.headline: the *sky* slowly shifts against the calendar
slides.body: earth's axis wobbles, so the stars behind the sun drift about one degree every 72 years. the sun does pass in front of ophiuchus each year. constellations are also different sizes, so the sun spends uneven time in each.

slides.headline: western signs follow the *seasons*, not the stars
slides.body: the tropical zodiac starts aries at the march equinox and cuts the year into 12 equal slices. by design, it never moves. your sign is the season you were born in, and that season is the same as it was.

slides.headline: you're still a *sagittarius*. you just learned a fun fact
slides.body: say the honest thing: astrology is a reading, and the astronomy is still true.
